title: “God is not in a hurry.
paragraphs:
“God is not in a hurry.
But He is always on time.”

If everything happened instantly,
we wouldn’t learn patience.
We wouldn’t grow in wisdom.
We wouldn’t learn to trust.

Delay is not denial.
Sometimes it’s development.
📖 “Let perseverance finish its work so that you may be mature and complete.” (James 1:4)

Before you rush God…
ask what He’s shaping in you.
